mapper.sql: k.employee_no as "employeeNo", k.name, coalesce(college.organization_code, dept.organization_code) as "collegeCode", coalesce(college.organization_name, dept.organization_name) as "collegeName", dept.organization_code as "departmentCode", dept.organization_name as "departmentName", k.rank_name as "rankName", k.retirement_date as "retirementDate"

from korus_personnel_snapshots k left join organizations dept on dept.organization_code = k.organization_code and dept.status = 'ACTIVE' left join organization_relations rel on rel.organization_code = k.organization_code and rel.status = 'ACTIVE' and rel.effective_start_date <= make_date(#{criteria.baseYear}, 12, 31) and (rel.effective_end_date is null or rel.effective_end_date >= make_date(#{criteria.baseYear}, 1, 1)) left join organizations college on college.organization_code = rel.parent_organization_code and college.status = 'ACTIVE'
